brief: Morning wrap: futures rallied (Nasdaq +70bps, S&P +40bps) as constructive but unresolved US/Iran talks on a phased Hormuz reopening pushed oil down 2.5% and yields off highs in a weekend relief move; the 10-year sat at 5.17% and Brent fell 1%. Trump's meeting with Xi yielded only a 2-month trade truce and APEC/G20 support, no breakthroughs. Single-stock headline: AKAM +20% after Anthropic signed an $11.6bn, seven-year CPU compute contract plus a warrant convertible into 7.7M AKAM shares, building on a prior $1.8bn deal; TWLO fell 3% on an HSBC downgrade. GS's hyperscaler capex framework: 2026 capex on track for $800bn, 2027 consensus $1.1tn; GS sees 2027 spend beating consensus but growth decelerating, with hyperscalers needing roughly $300bn in annual AI revenue to break even against capex, versus cloud revenue already $70bn above trend and $1.5tn of backlog. Meta Connect 2026 recap covers Muse's expansion, a new glasses lineup, VR Glasses (Spring 2027), Muse Charm and a pivot toward glasses as the primary AI interface. Telecom 3Q26E preview: EBITDA growth at TMUS/VZ/T versus declines at Charter and Comcast; SiriusXM's YouTube tie-up expands listener reach but its financial impact is not meaningful until 2H27.
